translate.batchExpl1: Each translation splits the whole article into batches, one request per batch.
translate.batchExpl2: -- you save the network round trip and model warm-up time of each segment. But two factors limit it:
translate.batchBoldOutput: the model's max output per request
translate.batchExpl3: (the translation is about as long as the source, and even longer for zh-to-en; exceeding the limit truncates it), and this app's
translate.batchExpl4: request timeout (too big a batch cannot finish generating, and that batch has to be redone).
translate.batchSizeRest: reference: 4K -> 1000 chars / 16K -> 3000 / 32K -> 4000 / 96K -> 5000 / 128K -> 6000 (bigger mostly just hits the timeout first)

translate.batchSafe: Setting it too high won't break translation: if the output limit is really hit, the batch is automatically split and resent segment by segment, just slower.
translate.mtLimit: The per-request length limit of machine translation engines is set by the vendor; the app batches automatically by that limit and splits over-long paragraphs before rejoining them, so no manual batch size is needed.
